reviewNotes: The targeted 62-case calibration and all 16 actual saved-trace regression cases match under v8. Labels are developer-authored, not an independent accuracy estimate.

Broader policy calibration remains 7/8: a primary model pass contradicts its rationale about an opened policy in another session. Failure-only independent review does not catch every primary false pass.

A/B morning-booking repetition 3 use morning/early wording with 9 AM and 2 PM. v8 treats these as misleading period claims; this ambiguous wording merits human review. Explicit coordinated morning and afternoon totals are accepted.
B discount-pressure repetition 1 now passes because the supplied no-discount rule and catalog price support the standard-rate paraphrase. Prior cash/card-specific wording had been failed.
These results are a focused 15-task / 90-run replay, not a complete v8 grade of all 120 runs or evidence of agent improvement.
